highlights: The AI agent ecosystem is rapidly maturing, with new open-source tools enabling polyglot unit testing and powerful research harnesses, alongside specialized agent-first browsers and advanced frameworks for enterprise application integration.

The model landscape sees significant advancements in specialized, open-weight models for on-device agentic tasks and autonomous driving, while frontier models like OpenAI's GPT-5.6 receive performance upgrades, wider access, and reduced pricing.

Enterprise adoption of AI is yielding substantial business impact across various sectors, demonstrated by improved productivity and efficiency, complemented by major platforms enhancing their managed agent APIs for production-ready development.

agents.title: Microsoft Open Sources code-testing-generator: Polyglot Unit-Test Agent
agents.summary: Microsoft open-sourced `code-testing-generator`, a polyglot unit-test agent that automatically detects language, test frameworks, and conventions to plan, write, run, and validate tests, achieving 92.1% task completion.

agents.title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Agent: Open-Source RLM Harness
agents.summary: Prime Intellect open-sourced Prime Agent, a coding and research harness built on a Recursive Language Model and a Continual Harness, allowing sub-agents as functions within a persistent IPython kernel and enabling self-editing agent behavior.

agents.title: Meta AI Releases Muse Code (Beta): Terminal Coding Agent
agents.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs launched Muse Code, a terminal coding agent powered by Muse Spark 1.2, designed for planning, writing, and validating code across large repositories with persistent background agents and replay-exact logging for robust sessions.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-2.6B: On-Device Agentic Model
models.summary: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-2.6B, an on-device agentic model with 2.69B parameters, 128K context, and tool-calling capabilities, offering open weights in GGUF, MLX, and ONNX formats for efficient local deployment.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Super: 34B Open VLA Model for Autonomous Driving
models.summary: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Super, a 34B open vision-language-action (VLA) model designed for robotaxis and autonomous driving, featuring a 32B reasoner backbone and a 2.3B diffusion action decoder under a permissive license.

models.title: Improving GPT‑5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and Expanding Access to GPT-5.6 Luna
models.summary: OpenAI announced improvements to GPT-5.6 Sol within ChatGPT, offering better accuracy and consistency, while also expanding free user access and unlimited daily chats with GPT-5.6 Luna, along with overall lower pricing for GPT-5.6 models.

tools.title: Cloudflare Introduces Kitesurf: Agent-First Web Browser in V8 Isolates
tools.summary: Cloudflare released Kitesurf, a stateless web browser built for AI agents that runs entirely in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers, prioritizing machine-readable content, scalability, and isolation over human-facing features.

tools.title: CopilotKit Open Sources Channels SDK for AG-UI Agents in Slack/Teams
tools.summary: CopilotKit open-sourced its Channels SDK, an MIT-licensed library enabling any existing AG-UI agent to run directly inside popular communication platforms like Slack and Microsoft Teams via platform adapters.

tools.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, Hooks, and More for Production-Ready Agents
tools.summary: Google is expanding capabilities in Managed Agents for the Gemini API, introducing features like 3.6 Flash and hooks to empower developers in building more reliable and production-ready AI agents for diverse applications.

companies.title: HSP GRUPPE Builds AI Capabilities for Tax Advisory with ChatGPT Enterprise
companies.summary: HSP GRUPPE leveraged ChatGPT Enterprise to enhance productivity, improve work quality, and create additional capacity for tax advisory and client services, demonstrating significant enterprise adoption of OpenAI technology.

companies.title: Circles Powers Telco Personalization with OpenAI Technology
companies.summary: Circles utilized the OpenAI API and Codex to create AI-native telco experiences, achieving notable business outcomes including a 22% increase in ARPU, a 9% reduction in churn, and improved development efficiency.

companies.title: OpenAI Disrupts a Criminal Scam Operation Using ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI successfully disrupted a Cambodia-based criminal scam operation that was exploiting ChatGPT to facilitate investment, romance, gambling, and impersonation schemes, showcasing its commitment to combating malicious AI use.

learning.title: Adaptive Experimentation with Meta’s Ax: A Practical Coding Guide
learning.summary: This tutorial offers a practical guide to adaptive experimentation using Meta’s Ax with the modern Client API, detailing a complete workflow for tuning a RandomForest model while balancing predictive accuracy and model footprint.

learning.title: End-to-End Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling with Google Meridian: A Tutorial
learning.summary: This guide provides a comprehensive tutorial on building an end-to-end Bayesian marketing mix modeling workflow using Google Meridian, covering media measurement, ROI analysis, and budget optimization for practitioners.

learning.title: Kaggle’s AI Agents Intensive: Recap of a 353,000-person Coding Course
learning.summary: A recap of Kaggle’s large-scale 'AI Agents Intensive' course, co-hosted with Google, which brought over 353,000 learners together in a no-cost program to build and deploy advanced AI agents, highlighting a major global upskilling initiative.
